title: RSS item and rendering contract
summary: Owns item rewriting, GUID behavior, namespace preservation, and final RSS serialization behavior.

public_contracts.name: FeedItem mutation helpers
public_contracts.summary: Rewrite only direct child nodes and preserve deterministic GUID and publication-date behavior.

public_contracts.name: RssRenderer::render
public_contracts.summary: Produces the final merged RSS document while preserving namespaced item children.

invariants.statement: Only direct item children participate in title, GUID, and pubDate rewrites.
GUID hashing remains deterministic and missing GUIDs derive from title plus description.
Namespaced item children survive rendering and their namespace declarations are hoisted to the root rss element.
The final merged feed remains sorted newest-first after all sources are combined.

performance_constraints: Rendering should preserve source XML structure rather than rebuilding item payloads field by field.

requires_adr: changing final sort order or serialization rules
